_about: Specs for scripts/world/hero_building.py: one entry per JindalX option, as the 2025-26 imagery shows the buildings (docs/JINDALX_VERIFICATION.md): 'facade' picks a spec-driven family (magnus, acp, a14, stucco); 'boxes' are the storeys' plans (metres from the front-left corner, levels l0..l1), 'bays' the Magnus podium openings, 'wall' the boundary style. 'known' lists what the workbook or a public filing says, 'assumed' what is inferred from imagery or design choice.

magnus-towers.name: MAGNUS TOWERS
known: B+G+5, 38,000 sq ft a floor, Grade A (workbook)
Magnus Greens, plot C-2 Sector 67: a ~131 x 28 m block (Google geocode and satellite 2026); a glass and glazing contract for C-2, Sept 2025 (Faalcon Concepts BSE filing)

architect renders (Sanjiv Tandon): white stone and plaster podium with glazed lobby bays, dark glass bands, stepped white aluminium-panel fascias, planted terraces, a rooftop pergola, a MAGNUS GREENS sign tower, three numbered entrances
boundary wall and a dense tree belt between the building and Sector 67 Rd (Street View 2026)
assumed: the tiering: which wing steps where (read off the renders, not the drawings)
the plot is the block grown by 10.5 m; the east-road gate is low confidence
the 38,000 sq ft a floor is not reproduced: the traced block is 3,670 m2 on the footprint, about 36,500 sq ft a floor

setbacks (4 m front, 0.6 m sides, 3 m rear), depth 36 m (a standard 450 m2 plot), the rear, roof plant
